captions.detailed: A monocular spotting scope finished in a uniform matte black. It consists of a flared cylindrical objective lens housing, a bulging central prism body, and a multi-segmented eyepiece. The eyepiece features a continuously rotating focus ring and a twist-out eyecup that revolves on a revolute joint, allowing adjustment along the optical axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a monocular spotting scope. The assembly should feature a cylindrical objective barrel, a central prism housing, a continuous-rotation focus ring, and a twist-out eyecup on a revolute joint, all styled in a dark matte finish.
captions.factory: The code constructs an articulated assembly starting with a fixed base representing the main body (prism housing and objective barrel). It then defines a continuous articulation joint for the focus ring, represented by a smaller cylinder. Finally, it adds a revolute articulation joint for the eyecup, modeled as a hollowed cylinder at the rear of the eyepiece.
